WTCA Saturday Ransom

Lubbock, TX · Ransom Canyon · Road

WTCA Saturday Ransom is a road group ride in Lubbock, TX. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Ransom Canyon Center parking lot. About 40, 62 or 70 miles, 16–19 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the WTCA Saturday Ransom group ride

The longer weekend version of the Ransom Canyon ride. Pick 40, 62 or 70 miles at 16 to 19 mph on hilly roads. Not a beginner ride. The club posts Saturday changes, gravel rides and pop-up rides on Facebook.
